name: trailing-bytes
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: A complete, otherwise-valid encoding with four extra bytes after it. The ABI decoder alone would ignore them; canonical form refuses them. Bytes that decode at all must decode to EXACTLY one claim, or a transaction carries a second object that only some readers see.
